existsisTidyintegraleqgridPeriod.name: Data.exists_isTidy_integral_eq_gridPeriod
existsisTidyintegraleqgridPeriod.statement:
lemma Data.exists_isTidy_integral_eq_gridPeriod : ∃ Φ, (∀ ϑ, IsTidy (4 * D.m) (D.path 0) (Φ ϑ)) ∧
  ∃ g α, ∃ r : D.gridLevelForms D.m →ₗ[ℂ] _, r.range = ⊤ ∧ ∀ (ϑ : D.MFoldTwist) Ξ φ,
  stdLevelIndex (D.levelY ϑ D.m) * ∫ x, Ξ x * D.liftChainY ϑ _ (r φ)
  x ∂(spaceY ..).quotMeasure = α * gridPeriod Φ (ϑ, Ξ, φ) zero_le g

HasRoute.name: Data.HasRoute
HasRoute.statement:
def Data.HasRoute {i j} (h : i ≤ D.m) (h' : j ≤ D.m) k := ∃ d : _ → ℂˣ, D.CostsSquares k (d ·) ∧ ∀ n
  Λ, (∀ ϑ, IsTidy n (D.path i) (Λ ϑ)) → ∃ Φ, (∀ ϑ, IsTidy (n + k) (D.path j) (Φ ϑ)) ∧ ∀ T : _ → ℂ,
  (∀ g, ∃ β, ∀ x, gridPeriod Φ x h' g = β * T x) → ∀ g, ∃ β, ∀ x, gridPeriod Λ x h g =
  β * (T x / d x.1)

hasRoutesucc.name: Data.hasRoute_succ
hasRoutesucc.statement: lemma Data.hasRoute_succ {j} (h : j < D.m) : D.HasRoute (j := j + 1) h.le h (4 * j + 2)

gridPeriodclimb.name: Data.gridPeriod_climb
gridPeriodclimb.statement: lemma Data.gridPeriod_climb {j} (h : j ≤ D.m) : D.HasRoute zero_le h (2 * j * j)

existsmulendPeriodmemembValRing.name: Data.exists_mul_endPeriod_mem_embValRing
existsmulendPeriodmemembValRing.statement:
lemma Data.exists_mul_endPeriod_mem_embValRing : ∃ N ≠ (0 : ℕ), N ≤ exp (D.x ^ 99 * D.b ^ 2) ∧
  ∀ {ϑ n} {Λ : GridDatum ϑ} {y p} [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p], IsTidy n (D.path D.m) Λ →
  FixedByEndLevels ϑ y → p.Coprime ϑ.levelNorm → (∀ z g, weylGauge _
  (endDetExp z 0) g ((D.endToAlgForm z (y z)).1 g) ≤ 1) → N * endPeriod Λ y ∈ embValRing

endPeriodle.name: Data.endPeriod_le

  IsTidy (4 * D.m + 2 * D.m * D.m) (D.path D.m) Λ) (hy : FixedByEndLevels 1 y)

cruderows.statement:

triangleOrdereqmullevelIndex.name: Data.triangleOrder_eq_mul_levelIndex
triangleOrdereqmullevelIndex.statement:

  FixedByEndLevels ϑ y) (S : ∀ _ _, _ → _ → Prop) {F M R} [NormedField F] (σ : ℂ →+* F) (hs : ∀ x z,
  ∀ j < D.m, ∀ g h v, S z j g v → S z _ h ((endKernel ϑ z j).jetMatrix ((endKernel ϑ z j).ω (g,
  h) (@endDatum _ D ϑ x z j)) v)) (hB : ∀ z g, S z 0 g ((D.endToAlgForm z (y z)).1 g)) (hA :

  (M * D.endPairing v' v)‖ ≤ R) : ∃ N ≤ tupleBound ϑ ^ n, endPeriod Λ y ∈ (N * ∏ z,
  ∏ j ∈ range (D.m + (!z).toNat), .card (StdClasses (endLevel ϑ z j))) • {a | ‖σ (M * a)‖ ≤ R}

  (∏ i ∈ Ico b D.m, triangleOrder false ϑ i * triangleOrder true ϑ i) * Φ fun S ↦ B

rankboundscardbigIndex.name: Data.rank_bounds_card_bigIndex
rankboundscardbigIndex.statement:

conjHolWeighteqaddkernelWeight.statement:

  (BigIndex j) (D.signsW j) (untwistedAuxPair j).ord (Pi.single 1 ((untwistedAuxPair j).colsPlus τ))

conjHolWeightkernelWeightbounds.name: Data.conjHolWeight_kernelWeight_bounds

lemma conjHolWeight_kernelWeight_bounds τ : let s := D.signsW j; let k := conjHolWeight j τ; (∀ i,
      |↑(k i)| ≤ 5 * D.b) ∧ IsKDominant s (orderW j) k ∧ IsKDominant s (orderW j) (kernelWeight j
      τ) ∧ HasHolGap s k (300 * nStar D) ∧ HasHolGap s (kernelWeight j τ) (300 * nStar D)

EdgeTuple.statement:

  Matrix (D'.NodeIndex e.2) (D'.NodeIndex e.1) (gridModulus ϑ).ResRing

IsMuEdge.name: Data.IsMuEdge
IsMuEdge.statement: abbrev IsMuEdge (p q : Node) := p.1 ↔ p.2.1 ≠ q.2.1

  (gridTamePart ϑ (IsMuEdge e.1 e.2) (ite (e.1.2.1 = e.2.2.1) e.1.2.2 e.1.2.1))

IsAdmissibleFamily.name: Data.IsAdmissibleFamily

tupleAction.name: Data.tupleAction
tupleAction.statement: def tupleAction (S : EdgeTuple ϑ') (e : Node × Node) := (g e.2)⁻¹.1 * S e * (g e.1).1

edgeCharProd.name: Data.edgeCharProd
edgeCharProd.statement:
def edgeCharProd (w : Finset (Node × Node)) : ℂ := ∏ e ∈ w,
  (edgeChar ϑ' e).toUnitHom ((g e.2).det / (g e.1).det)

tupleBound.name: Data.tupleBound
tupleBound.statement: abbrev tupleBound := card (D'.gridModulus ϑ).ResRing ^ (2 * D'.n D'.m) ^ 2

LeftInvOnMuEdges.name: Data.LeftInvOnMuEdges
LeftInvOnMuEdges.statement:
abbrev LeftInvOnMuEdges (S : EdgeTuple ϑ') (w : Finset (Node × Node)) := ∀ e ∈ w, IsMuEdge e.1 e.2 →
  HasLeftInv (S e)

IsShortSum.name: Data.IsShortSum

bind.name: Data.GridDatum.bind
bind.statement:
abbrev GridDatum.bind {D : Data P} {ϑ : D.MFoldTwist} (Λ : GridDatum ϑ) {X : Type} [Fintype X] (κ :
  _ → X → ℂ) (t : _ → X → _) := (Λ ∘ₗ .pi fun S ↦ ∑ x, κ S x • .proj (t S x) : GridDatum ϑ)

IsTidy.name: Data.IsTidy
IsTidy.statement:
structure IsTidy {D : Data P} {ϑ : D.MFoldTwist} (n : ℕ) (w : Finset (Node × Node)) (Λ :
  GridDatum ϑ) where
  equivariant g : IsAdmissibleFamily g → ∀ f, Λ (f <| tupleAction g ·) = edgeCharProd g w * Λ f
  isShortSum : IsShortSum n w Λ

IsLevelTidy.name: Data.IsLevelTidy
IsLevelTidy.statement:
def IsLevelTidy (w : Finset (Node × Node)) (Λ : GridDatum ϑ') := IsShortSum n w Λ ∧ ∀ g, (∀ z, ∀ i ≤
  D'.m, g (z, 0, i) ∈ nodeLevel ..) → ∀ f, Λ (f <| tupleAction g ·) = edgeCharProd g w * Λ f

verticalEdge.name: Data.verticalEdge
verticalEdge.statement: abbrev verticalEdge (z : Bool) (a b : ℕ) := ((z, a, b), z, a, b + 1)

rowEdge.name: Data.rowEdge
rowEdge.statement: abbrev rowEdge (z : Bool) (a b : ℕ) := ((z, a, b), z, a + 1, b)

legEdges.name: Data.legEdges
legEdges.statement: def legEdges (z : Bool) (b : ℕ) := (Ico b D'.m).image (verticalEdge z 0)

gridPath.name: Data.gridPath
gridPath.statement: def gridPath (z : Bool) (a b : ℕ) := (range a).image (rowEdge z · b) ∪ D'.legEdges z b

path.name: Data.path
path.statement: abbrev path := D'.gridPath false n n ∪ D'.gridPath true n n

legDescents.name: Data.legDescents
legDescents.statement:
def legDescents b : D.GridForm z 0 D.m →ₗ[ℂ] D.GridForm z 0 b := if b < D.m then descentMove (S
  (verticalEdge ..)) ∘ₗ legDescents _ else
  Pi.single (M := (D.GridForm .. →ₗ[ℂ] D.GridForm z 0 ·)) _ .id b

gridPathMap.name: Data.gridPathMap
gridPathMap.statement:
def gridPathMap : ∀ a b, D.GridForm z 0 D.m →ₗ[ℂ] D.GridForm z a b
  | 0, _ => legDescents S .. | _ + 1, _ => liftMove (S (rowEdge ..)) ∘ₗ gridPathMap ..

diagonalPeriodForm.name: Data.diagonalPeriodForm
diagonalPeriodForm.statement:
@[simp] def diagonalPeriodForm h g := (Space.periodPairing (isConjKernelPair_gridKernel ⟨h, h⟩) ⟨1,
  ⟨fun x ↦ .reindex (D.gridDiagEquiv j) _ (.sum (x, 1, (gridModulus ϑ₁).flipScalar ^ j)), by
  fun_prop⟩, ⟨1, 0, by simp⟩, _, fun _ ↦ gridSpace_diag h ▸ (Space.height_reindex ..).trans_le
  (Space.height_sum_le ..)⟩ g : D.GridForm .. →ₗ[ℂ] GridForm .. →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)

gridPeriod.name: Data.gridPeriod
gridPeriod.statement:
@[simp] def gridPeriod (Λ : ∀ ϑ, D.GridDatum ϑ) (y : _ × _ × _) h g := Λ y.1 fun S ↦
  diagonalPeriodForm y.1 h g
  (gridPathMap S _ j j (levelIndex y.1 false 0 D.m • y.2.1)) (gridPathMap S _ j j y.2.2)

edgeCharProdmul.name: Data.edgeCharProd_mul
edgeCharProdmul.statement:
lemma edgeCharProd_mul g' : edgeCharProd (g * g') w =

legDescentscongr.statement:

binda.name: Data.IsShortSum.bind
binda.statement:
lemma IsShortSum.bind {n k w w' X} [Fintype X] {κ : _ → X → ℂ} {t} {Λ : GridDatum ϑ} (N : card X ≤
  tupleBound ϑ ^ k) (H : ∀ S x, κ S x ≠ 0 → LeftInvOnMuEdges S w → IsOfFinOrder (κ S x) ∧
  LeftInvOnMuEdges (t S x) w') : IsShortSum n w Λ → IsShortSum
  (n + k) w' (Λ.bind κ t) | ⟨_, W, c, s, h⟩ => ⟨_, W ×ˢ ⊤, (c • κ ∘ s).uncurry, (t ∘
  s).uncurry, by simp [pow_add, mul_le_mul', sum_product, mul_sum, *]; grind [IsOfFinOrder.mul]⟩

cardmatrixletupleBound.name: Data.card_matrix_le_tupleBound
cardmatrixletupleBound.statement:

    card (Matrix (D.NodeIndex p) (D.NodeIndex q) (gridModulus ϑ).ResRing) ≤ tupleBound ϑ

EndIndex.name: Data.EndIndex
EndIndex.statement: abbrev EndIndex := D.GridIndex z a D.m

endWeightData.name: Data.endWeightData
endWeightData.statement:
def endWeightData : let ι := D.EndIndex z; Σ' κ, Σ' e : ℕ → _, (∀ j,
    IsLiftWeight (ι j) (ι (j + 1)) κ (D.gridWeight z j (ι (j + 1))) (e j) ∧ D.gridWeight z j (ι j) =
    e (j + 1)) ∧ ∀ j ≤ D.m, IsHCParam κ (e j) (-D.gridParam z 0 j D.m) := by
  intro ι; have hp j h := D.paramsCorrespond_grid true z 0 j _ rfl h .refl
  have s :=
    @strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ _ _ (Fintype.card <| ι ·) (by simp [ι, card_gridIndex, D.t_odd.pos])
  choose κ H using exists_isHCParam_of_le (e := D.gridWeight z 0 (ι 1)) (fun _ ↦
    (Set.range (Fintype.card <| ι ·)).indicator fun _ ↦ D.h - D.t - z.toNat)
    (D.hasGap_gridParam · z 0 D.m |>.neg) (hp 0 D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound · |>.rec (by
    simp [IsMatchedPair, pairSign, gridSigns_eq_one]; grind-ring -linarith -ac -order))
  refine ⟨κ, _, (⟨·, Nat.rec (fun _ ↦ H.1) (by grind [IsHCParam.paramsCorrespond_iff,
    gridSigns_eq_one])⟩) fun j ↦ .imp_left (⟨·, s (by simp), rfl⟩) ?_⟩
  simp +contextual [ι, H, FitsRanks, s.monotone.ne_of_lt_of_lt_nat j, funext_iff, s _, (s.monotone
    j.zero_le).trans_lt]; cases z <;> simp [gridWeight, card_gridIndex] <;> grind

  (gridModulus ϑ₁).levelOfSubgroup (n := EndIndex z b') (nodeLevel ϑ₁ (z, b', D.m)) deriving IsLevel

isStdgridSpace.statement: instance isStd_gridSpace {z i} : (D.gridSpace 0 z i D.m).IsStd

FixedByEndLevels.statement:
abbrev FixedByEndLevels (y : ∀ _, _) := ∀ z,
  D.endToAlgForm z (y z) ∈ levelSpace (algFormRep ..) (endLevel ϑ₁ ..)

endDatum.name: Data.endDatum
endDatum.statement:
def endDatum j := P.vacuumScale D.s ^ Fintype.card (D.EndIndex z j.succ × D.EndIndex z j) •
  vacuumDatum (stdSpace ..) (stdSpace ..) _ (Pi.single (S (rowEdge z j D.m)) 1)

endChain.name: Data.endChain
endChain.statement: abbrev endChain j F := chain (endKernel ϑ z) (endDatum S z) j (D.endToAlgForm z F)

endPeriod.name: Data.endPeriod
endPeriod.statement:
def endPeriod (Λ : GridDatum ϑ) (y : ∀ _, _) := Λ fun S ↦ let c z := (endChain S z _ (y z)).1
  classIntegral stdRatPoints (endLevel ϑ ..) fun h ↦ D.endPairing (c _ h) (c _ (endBlockPoint ϑ h))

existssquaremove.name: Data.IsTidy.exists_square_move
existssquaremove.statement:
lemma IsTidy.exists_square_move {P} {D : Data P} {ϑ z a b n w} {Λ : GridDatum ϑ} {p v Q U R} r {T J}
  [Fintype T] (τ : D.GridIndex z a b ≃ D.NodeIndex U) (σ : D.NodeIndex p ⊕ T ≃ D.NodeIndex Q) (ρ :
  D.NodeIndex r ⊕ T ≃ D.NodeIndex R) (ψ : AddChar _ ℂ) {χ ε C} {L M : J → _} (q : ∀ i,
  SquareLaw χ ε C (L i) (M i)) (hQ : ∀ g, @IsAdmissibleFamily _ D ϑ g →
  g R = blockInlGL ρ (g r) ∧ ∀ k, let u := update (update g p k) Q (blockInlGL σ k)
  IsAdmissibleFamily u ∧ u p = k) (h : U ≠ v ∧ (IsMuEdge Q U ∧ ¬IsMuEdge U R ∨ IsMuEdge p v ∧
  ¬IsMuEdge v r) ∧ (∀ q ∈ [U, R, v, r], q.2 ≤ (D.m, D.m) ∧ q ∉ [p, Q]) ∧ ∀ e ∈ w, e.1 ∉ [p, Q] ∧ e.2
  ∉ [p, Q, R, r]) (H : IsTidy n (insert (p, v) (insert (Q, U) w)) Λ) (X : χ = (edgeChar ϑ (p, v) *
  edgeChar ϑ (Q, U))⁻¹ ∧ edgeChar ϑ (U, R) = edgeChar ϑ (p, v) ∧ edgeChar ϑ (v, r) = edgeChar ϑ (Q,
  U) := by simp [edgeChar]) : ∃ Φ, IsTidy (n + 2) (insert (U, R) (insert (v, r) w)) Φ ∧ ∀ f : _ →
  _ → J, DependsOn f w → Λ (fun S ↦ let x := (S (Q, U)).submatrix τ σ; ∑ k, ψ (k * x.toCols₂).trace
    * M (f S k) (fromRows (S (p, v)) x.toCols₁)) = C * Φ fun S ↦ let x := (S (U, R)).submatrix ρ τ
  L (f S x.toRows₂) (fromCols (S (v, r)) x.toRows₁)

GridIndex.name: Data.GridIndex
GridIndex.statement:
protected def GridIndex j := BlockIndex (BlockIndex (BlockIndex D.RowIndex Unit z.toNat)
  (Fin (D.t + z.toNat)) i) (Fin (D.t - z.toNat)) j deriving Fintype

gridNumber.name: Data.gridNumber
gridNumber.statement:
def gridNumber : BlockIndex D.RowIndex Unit z.toNat ≃ Fin (D.r + z.toNat) :=
  z.rec D.basisNumber ((D.basisNumber.sumCongr finOneEquiv.symm).trans finSumFinEquiv)

gridBlockEquiv.name: Data.gridBlockEquiv
gridBlockEquiv.statement: def gridBlockEquiv {z i} := show D.GridIndex z i j ≃ _ from equivSum (equivSum (D.gridNumber z) i) j

entrySigneq.name: Data.entrySign_eq
entrySigneq.statement: lemma entrySign_eq j a : entrySign o j a = ite ((o + a + min (a - o) j) % 2 = 1) (-1) 1

gridSigns.name: Data.gridSigns
gridSigns.statement:
def gridSigns j (x : D.GridIndex z i j) :=
  (D.gridBlockEquiv x).elim (Sum.elim (entrySign o j <| ·.1 + 1 - D.k) 1) 1

gridParam.name: Data.gridParam
gridParam.statement:
def gridParam j (τ : D.Φ) : HCParam (D.gridSigns z o i j) := fun x ↦
  let y := (D.gridBlockEquiv x).elim (Sum.elim (2 * D.rowParameter τ ·.1) fun (l, b) ↦ 2 * D.w
    (l + 1) τ + D.t - 1 - 2 * b) fun (l, b) ↦ D.t - 1 - 2 * (D.w (l + 1 + o) τ + z.toNat) - 2 * b
  bif z then y + 1 else ite ((j + i) % 2 = 1) (y - 1) y

signsY.name: Data.signsY
signsY.statement: def signsY j : D.Y j → ℤˣ := D.gridSigns false 0 0 j

paramY.name: Data.paramY
paramY.statement: def paramY j : D.Φ → D.Y j → ℤ := D.gridParam false 0 0 j

gridWeight.name: Data.gridWeight
gridWeight.statement: def gridWeight c l (n : Type) [Fintype n] τ := (((card n + (!c).toNat) / 2 :) - D.w (l + 1) τ : ℤ)

gridHarmonic.name: Data.gridHarmonic

cardgridIndex.name: Data.card_gridIndex
cardgridIndex.statement:
lemma card_gridIndex : card (D.GridIndex z i j) =
  D.r + z.toNat + i * (D.t + z.toNat) + j * (D.t - z.toNat)

cardneggridSignseqsum.name: Data.card_neg_gridSigns_eq_sum
cardneggridSignseqsum.statement:
lemma card_neg_gridSigns_eq_sum : negCount (D.gridSigns z o i j) = ∑ n ∈ range (D.r + z.toNat), ite
  (entrySign o j (n + 1 - D.k) = -1) 1 0

cardneggridSigns.name: Data.card_neg_gridSigns
cardneggridSigns.statement: lemma card_neg_gridSigns z i j : negCount (D.gridSigns z 0 i j) = (D.m - j + z.toNat) / 2

gridDiagEquiv.name: Data.gridDiagEquiv
gridDiagEquiv.statement:
def gridDiagEquiv : ∀ j, D.GridIndex false j j ⊕ Unit ≃ D.GridIndex true j j
  | 0 => .refl _ | j + 1 => (exists_equiv_of_card_neg (b := Sum.elim _ fun _ ↦ (-1) ^ min (j + 1)
    D.m) (by simp [card_gridIndex]; zify [D.t_odd.pos]; lia) (by
    rw [negCount_sumElim, card_neg_gridSigns, card_neg_gridSigns, negCount, neg_one_pow_eq_ite]
    split <;> simp <;> grind)).choose.symm

gridDiagEquivspec.name: Data.gridDiagEquiv_spec
gridDiagEquivspec.statement:
lemma gridDiagEquiv_spec (h : j ≤ D.m) :
  Sum.elim (D.gridSigns false 0 j j) (fun _ ↦ (-1) ^ j) ∘ (D.gridDiagEquiv j).symm =
  D.gridSigns true 0 j j

cardgridIndexmodtwo.name: Data.card_gridIndex_mod_two
cardgridIndexmodtwo.statement: lemma card_gridIndex_mod_two z i j : card (D.GridIndex z i j) % 2 = ite z 0 ((i + j + 1) % 2)

waddgaple.name: Data.w_add_gap_le
waddgaple.statement: lemma w_add_gap_le a b (h : a < b) : D.w a τ + ite (a + 1 < b) 2 1 * D.h ≤ D.w b τ

gridSignseqone.name: Data.gridSigns_eq_one
gridSignseqone.statement: lemma gridSigns_eq_one (h : D.m ≤ j) : D.gridSigns z 0 i j = 1

hasGapgridParam.name: Data.hasGap_gridParam
hasGapgridParam.statement:
lemma hasGap_gridParam z i j (o := 0) (H : o = 0 ∨ i = 0 := by simp) : (D.gridParam z o i j
  τ).HasGap D.h

gridParaminterlace.name: Data.gridParam_interlace
gridParaminterlace.statement:
lemma gridParam_interlace x : (#{j | x < -D.gridParam true 0 D.m D.m τ j} - #{i | x < D.gridParam
  false 0 D.m D.m τ i} : ℤ) ∈ Icc 0 1

absgridParamle.name: Data.abs_gridParam_le
absgridParamle.statement: lemma abs_gridParam_le : i ≤ D.m → j ≤ D.m → ∀ x, |D.gridParam z 0 i j τ x| ≤ ⌈20 * D.b⌉₊

cardgridIndexle.name: Data.card_gridIndex_le
cardgridIndexle.statement: lemma card_gridIndex_le (h : i ≤ D.m ∧ j ≤ D.m) : card (D.GridIndex z i j) ≤ 2 * D.n D.m

paramsCorrespondgrid.name: Data.paramsCorrespond_grid
paramsCorrespondgrid.statement:
lemma paramsCorrespond_grid d z o i j {c l i' j'} (e : (c, l, i', j') = bif d then (z, i, i + 1,
  j) else (!z, j + o, i, j + 1)) (hi : i' ≤ D.m := by lia) (hj : j' ≤ D.m := by lia) (H : o = 0 ∨
  i' = 0 := by lia) : ParamsCorrespond (D.gridWeight c l (D.GridIndex z i j))
  (D.gridWeight c l (D.GridIndex z i' j')) (negIf d (D.gridParam z o i j))
  (negIf d (D.gridParam z o i' j')) (D.gridSigns z o i j) (D.gridSigns z o i' j')

binders.name: e
binders.type: (c, l, i', j') = bif d then (z, i, i + 1, j) else (!z, j + o, i, j + 1)

paramsCorrespondfirstarrow.name: Data.paramsCorrespond_first_arrow
paramsCorrespondfirstarrow.statement:
lemma paramsCorrespond_first_arrow z (h : i + j < D.m) :
    let δ n τ := card (D.GridIndex z 0 n) - D.gridWeight (!z) (0 + i) (D.GridIndex z 0 n) τ
    let P o j o' j' := ParamsCorrespond (δ j) (δ j') (-D.gridParam z o 0 j) (-D.gridParam z o' 0 j')
      (D.gridSigns z o 0 j)
      (D.gridSigns z o' 0 j'); P (i + 1) j i (j + 1) ∧ P i (j + 1) (i + 1) j

pow.name: Data.TameChar.pow
pow.statement:
noncomputable def Data.TameChar.pow ϑ n :=
  @mk P D (toAutChar ϑ ^ n) _ (ϑ.ψ ^ n) (mod_cast ϑ.hasWeight.zpow n) (by simp_all [ϑ.5]) ϑ.6 ϑ.7

MFoldTwist.name: Data.MFoldTwist
MFoldTwist.statement:
structure Data.MFoldTwist (D :
  Data P) extends D.Twist where pow_ne_one : ∀ n ∈ D.LiftIndex, ∀ w ∈ Q, ψ w ^ n ≠ 1

chainChar.name: Data.chainChar

instOneTws.name: Data.instOneTws
instOneTws.statement: noncomputable instance Data.instOneTws (D : Data P) : One D.MFoldTwist

instCoeTwsTwist.name: Data.instCoeTwsTwist

ratio.name: Data.Pair.ratio
ratio.statement:
noncomputable def Data.Pair.ratio (p : D.Pair) (ϑ : D.TameChar) (s : ℤˣ := 1) := (‖(p.ν *
  ϑ.toAutChar ^ s.1)⁻¹.L ({w | D.IsChosen w} ∪ ϑ.Q) p.z‖ / ‖p.ν⁻¹.L {w | D.IsChosen w} p.z‖ : ℂ)

existssquareLawgrid.name: Data.exists_squareLaw_grid
existssquareLawgrid.statement:
lemma Data.exists_squareLaw_grid z (h : a < D.m) (m : b < D.m) : ∃ κ σ, ∃ c : _ → ℂˣ, D.CostsSquares
  1 (c ·) ∧ ∀ ϑ (l : _ × (GridForm z (a + 1) b →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)), SquareLaw (edgeChar ϑ (verticalEdge z a
  b) * edgeChar ϑ (rowEdge z a b))⁻¹ σ (κ / c ϑ) (fun x ↦ l.2 (descentMove x.toCols₂
  (liftMove x.toCols₁ l.1))) fun y ↦ l.2 (liftMove y.toRows₂ (descentMove y.toRows₁ l.1))

descentpastgridPathMap.name: Data.descent_past_gridPathMap
descentpastgridPathMap.statement:
lemma Data.descent_past_gridPathMap {P} {D : Data P} {a b} (h : b < D.m) z (h' : a ≤ b) : ∃ κ, ∃ c :
    _ → ℂˣ, D.CostsSquares a (c ·) ∧ ∀ ϑ n w Λ,
  (∀ e ∈ w, z ∉ [e.1.1, e.2.1] ∨ ∃ i ≥ a, e = rowEdge z i b) → IsTidy n (w ∪ D.gridPath z a b) Λ →
  ∃ Φ, IsTidy (n + 2 * a) (insert (verticalEdge z a b) (D.gridPath z a (b + 1)) ∪ w) Φ ∧ ∀ F
  (l : EdgeTuple ϑ → _ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ), DependsOn l w → Λ (fun S ↦ l S (gridPathMap S z a b F)) =
  κ / c ϑ * Φ fun S ↦ l S (descentMove (S (verticalEdge z a b)) (gridPathMap S z a _ F))

iotaPlusadjointweightedChain.name: Data.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain
iotaPlusadjointweightedChain.statement:
lemma Data.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain {P} (D : Data P) z ϑ {i} (h : i ≤ D.m) y
    : let U := weightedChain (triangleOrder z) (D.triLift z) ϑ 0 i y; let ι := iotaPlus ϑ z
    (i ≠ 0 → (∀ φ u, (triangleModulus z ϑ).reductionK₀ u = 1 → formRep _ _ u.1 (ι (i - 1) φ) = ι _
      φ) ∧ ∀ u, (triangleModulus z ϑ).reductionK₀ u = 1 → formRep _ _ u.1 U = U) ∧ ∀ φ, ∫ g, ι i φ
      g * U g ∂(D.gridSpace ..).quotMeasure = ∫ g, ι 0 φ g * y g ∂(D.gridSpace ..).quotMeasure

eqzeroofpeterssonrestricteqzero.name: eq_zero_of_petersson_restrict_eq_zero
eqzeroofpeterssonrestricteqzero.statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_petersson_restrict_eq_zero {P : Parameters} {D : Data P} (n : Type) [Fintype n]
  [Nonempty n] {s : n → ℤˣ} {V : Space D.E n s} (A : ℕ) {L N : ℕ} (β : ℝ) {m : ℝ} {t :
  n ⊕ Unit → ℤˣ} {l : _ → HCParam s} {l' : _ → HCParam t} {e : s ⊕ᵥ 1 = t} (hg : ∀ w,
  (l w).HasLargeGap (4 * A)) (hg' : ∀ w, (l' w).HasLargeGap (2 * A)) (hl : ∀ w i, |l w i| ≤ L)
  (hA : 8 * (Fintype.card n + 1) ^ 2 < A) (hN : N < A) (hA' : 2 * D.f * (Fintype.card n + 1) + 2 ≤
  A) (hc : D.gProd * cuspConst D.E n D.cycloConductor ^ 2 ≤ β) (hβ : 2000 *
  (Fintype.card n + L + 1) ^ 6 ≤ β) (fβ : D.f ≤ β) (hm : β ^ (20 * A * (D.f + 1)) ≤ m) (hR : ∀ w,
  m ^ (3 * Fintype.card n + 2) ≤ ‖Φ w D.gridLevelGen.val‖) (H : ∀ w, ∃ ω : USign _, ‖ω.1.1‖ ^ 2 ≤ β
  ∧ volume.real {r : USign s | ‖r.1.1 - 1‖ ≤ 1} ≤ β ^ N * ‖∫ r : USign s, (l w).dsCoeff r * conj
  ((toHCParam (s ⊕ᵥ 1) (l' w)).dsCoeff (ω⁻¹ * inl s 1 r * ω).1.1)‖) : ∃ g, ∀ y ∈ levelSpace
  (V.formRep (typeKernel l s)) D.chosenLevel, (∀ φ ∈ levelSpace (((V.sum (signedSpace ..)).reindex
  (.refl _) e).formRep (typeKernel l' t)) (principalLevel _ D.gridLevelGen), V.petersson y
  (fun x ↦ φ (G.reindex (.refl _) e (.sum (x, 1)) * (g, 1))) = 0) → y.1 = 0

binders.name: hc
binders.type: D.gProd * cuspConst D.E n D.cycloConductor ^ 2 ≤ β

binders.name: hR
binders.type: ∀ w, m ^ (3 * Fintype.card n + 2) ≤ ‖Φ w D.gridLevelGen.val‖

binders.name: H
binders.type: ∀ w, ∃ ω : USign _, ‖ω.1.1‖ ^ 2 ≤ β ∧ volume.real {r : USign s | ‖r.1.1 - 1‖ ≤ 1} ≤ β ^ N * ‖∫ r : USign s, (l w).dsCoeff r * conj ((toHCParam (s ⊕ᵥ 1) (l' w)).dsCoeff (ω⁻¹ * inl s 1 r * ω).1.1)‖

eqzerooforthogonalgridLevelForms.name: Data.eq_zero_of_orthogonal_gridLevelForms
eqzerooforthogonalgridLevelForms.statement:
lemma Data.eq_zero_of_orthogonal_gridLevelForms {P} (D : Data P) : ∃ g,
  ∀ y ∈ D.principalForms (D.spaceY 0), (∀ φ ∈ D.gridLevelForms 0, (spaceY ..).petersson y (fun x ↦
  φ (G.reindex (.refl _) D.gridSigns_zero.symm (.sum (x, 1)) * (g, 1))) = 0) → y.1 = 0

  _, ∀ τ, IsSteep (D.gridParam z 0 0 0 τ) (D.w 0 τ) e
